facts.fact: 卡车跨座：她跨过中控坐进他怀里——他一句命令式「告诉我你要什么」；她卡壳，他咬颈安抚「Don't be shy now, Maggie」；她终于说出口：「Take me upstairs. And fuck me in my bed.」
facts.anchor: Tell me what you want,” he ordered

facts.fact: 上楼序章：他交底幻想清单（办公桌、那张该死的沙发）与上次的 lavender 香味、没铺的床——「就在这扇门后」；她找钥匙找不准因为他一直吻她脖颈——「I can't focus when you do that」「I'm sorry I'm such a distraction」——毫不抱歉。

facts.fact: 花洒谈判：她要求先洗澡「烟味汗味」；他引用 Branagh's Aubade 的译文「土腥如柴烟」——她笑「他们没有自来水」；他 tarried 看她 hesitate——「It was dark last night…」她怕白昼下被看全；他求「Please. Let me see all of you.」
facts.anchor: Isn’t that how Niamh describes Branagh’s smell? ‘Something earthy, like woodsmoke.’

facts.fact: 白昼真相时刻：解扣放出的瞬间他惊叹「You're stunning. You must know that.」她摇头——他呻吟着滚弄「I want to kiss every inch of you」；她笑拒「Not until every inch of me has seen soap」。
facts.anchor: You’re stunning. You must know that.

facts.fact: 记忆盘点：他撩起一缕发梳理——「咒破时我最庆幸的是重新记起你头发在火光里的样子」；她问「你还记得什么」；他答「The way we fit together. The way you tasted.」——热水将尽，两人火烧。

facts.fact: 床上：他跪床尾拉她到边沿、像欣赏一件艺术品般逐寸看；「Beautiful」；她拉他上来跨坐——「That I love that there are still surprises in the world」；她主动「You've been so patient…Let me take care of you.」他握她的手吻掌心再引下去。
facts.anchor: Marveling that, soon, if she got her way, he’d be inside her.

facts.fact: 她的反将：他喊停在嘴前「I don't want to come in your mouth」；她目光如焰反问「Where do you want to come, Arthur?」；他取床头柜上的 condom（淋浴前备好）——她饿着看每个动作。
facts.anchor: Where do you want to come, Arthur?

facts.fact: 入正题：他抵在入口却不进、先吃她胸「她把他的名字念成咒语」；「Is this what you wanted, Maggie? When you begged me to bring you up here and fuck you in your bed?」「Yes. Please.」——一点一点没入，两人同时 gasp；「You feel so good.」

facts.fact: 收束：他悬身不压重量、只呼吸——她看着两人交合处的画面；「You're perfect」他近乎 moan；「Will you come for me again?」——她第二次潮落、低语「Come inside me」——他加速追随她越过边缘。
